source.title: Neural control of body-plan axis in regenerating planaria
source.location: Fig 7I-N; Results text (counts e.g. 11/140); S3 Dataset pcbi.1006904.s018.xlsx sheet 'Figure 7' (labels panels 4I-4N)

stage: trunk-region fragment cut from a 2H worm, short piece carrying one head
injury: short fragment containing one head, cut in the 2H worm

intervention.timing: octanol 3-day soak in a prior regeneration round; recut at least 1 month after regeneration completed
intervention.duration: 3 days (prior round); no treatment this round
intervention.description: worms with a head at each end (made earlier with octanol) cut to leave a short fragment carrying one of the heads; no drug this round

readout.method: visual scoring of head number in regenerates
readout.timepoint: 2 weeks after cutting (1 week at 20 C, 1 week at 13 C)

notes: Counts from S3 Dataset xlsx (1H/2H columns) and match the Results text. 1H regenerates mapped to normal, 2H to double_head. The varied factor is cut geometry; octanol was applied to the donor worms (3-day soak) at least 1 month before this cut. Methods and Results disagree on which of the N=90 and N=140 fragments crosses the symmetry line; descriptions follow the xlsx cut labels and Results.

adjudication.note: A excluded all rows (cut geometry is the varied factor); B included the octanol-lineage 2H cut series. Kept for consistency with lineage rows elsewhere (donor worms made with 127 uM octanol); intervention confidence lowered
